20261007-124338-b3f3.title: Kyo's Orochinagi flame stays as long as in KOF98 (and the MAX throws three)
20261007-124338-b3f3.do: With a full meter and Ryo far away, press D (Orochinagi) and let go, then watch the flame until it is gone. Then do the MAX version: down+D.
20261007-124338-b3f3.expect: The big flame burns for about three quarters of a second after it comes out (not a few frames), Kyo keeps fire in his raised hand afterwards, and a last small flame pops in his hand at the end of the move. The MAX version (down+D) throws three flames one after another, each a step further forward.

20261007-124409-b3f3.title: Kyo's 236C punch has its fire in the hand
20261007-124409-b3f3.do: Press forward + C (Kyo's dashing 236C punch) with Ryo out of reach and watch his fist at the end of the punch.
20261007-124409-b3f3.expect: A burst of fire shows on Kyo's fist as the punch reaches out, as in KOF98, and dies out by itself.

20261007-124437-b3f3.title: Kyo's forward + C (EX 421D flying kick) is invincible
20261007-124437-b3f3.do: In a fight, let enemies come close and attack you, then press forward + C in the middle of them, several times.
20261007-124437-b3f3.expect: From the start of the kick to Kyo's landing no enemy hit, grab or push reaches him (his life does not drop); he can be hit again right after he lands.

todo196-throw-hitch.title: Terry's throw: the thrown enemy flies in one smooth arc
todo196-throw-hitch.do: Walk into Ryo to grab him, then forward + A (Terry's forward throw). Watch Ryo's flight, especially the moment Terry can move again.
todo196-throw-hitch.expect: Ryo flies in one smooth arc and lands: no stop and jump in his flight at the moment Terry is free to act (before the fix he stalled one frame there, then jumped two steps).

todo133-kim-214B.title: Kim: C (neutral) is Kizuna's 214B, played from its handler
todo133-kim-214B.do: Press C (no direction) next to the dummy, then again from far away.
todo133-kim-214B.expect: Kim crouches, then slides forward with the staff (about 85 px when it misses) and swings it up: two hits on the dummy, the last one launching. From far away the whole slide plays and he recovers in place.

todo134-kim-236C.title: Kim: forward + C is Kizuna's 236C rush with its two follow-ups
todo134-kim-236C.do: Press forward + C next to the dummy, then forward + C again during the rush, and once more during the second part.
todo134-kim-236C.expect: A 3-hit staff rush; the second press adds a lunging strike (98), the third a spinning finish that knocks down (9A). Without the extra presses he ends after the rush.

todo135-kim-28C.title: Kim: down + C is Kizuna's rising staff ([2]8C), down + A after a hit dives
todo135-kim-28C.do: Press down + C next to the dummy; on a second try, press down + A while he is high in the air after the hit.
todo135-kim-28C.expect: Kim rises straight up with the staff and the blue pillar, then falls back and lands. With down + A after a hit he dives forward onto the dummy instead (a blue flash at his feet) and lands.

todo137-kim-236A.title: Kim: down-forward + C is Kizuna's tag-in strike (236A)
todo137-kim-236A.do: Press down-forward + C next to the dummy.
todo137-kim-236A.expect: Like neutral C's slide but quicker to start (Kizuna's tag-in version): the slide and the rising swing, the dummy launched.

20261006-155421-b3f3.title: WHP Hanzo: throws on A+B
20261006-155421-b3f3.do: Walk into Ryo, then press A+B (also try forward + A+B and back + A+B).
20261006-155421-b3f3.expect: Hanzo grabs Ryo and throws him (forward throw, back throw over his shoulder), as in World Heroes Perfect.

20261006-155218-b3f3.title: Select screen: Yashiro not hidden behind K'
20261006-155218-b3f3.do: Look at the select screen, then move the cursor onto Yashiro and onto K'.
20261006-155218-b3f3.expect: Yashiro and K' stand apart, both fully visible, each arrow over its own fighter.

20261006-155158-b3f3.title: COIN inserts a credit
20261006-155158-b3f3.expect: The CREDIT count goes up by one with KOF94's coin sound; START then starts the game.

20261007-140259-5d29.title: Credits in: PRESS START replaces INSERT COIN
20261007-140259-5d29.do: The logo with INSERT COIN blinking and CREDIT 00. Press COIN once. Then try it again from the attract demo fight (wait about 20 s on the logo without a coin, then a coin during the demo fight).
20261007-140259-5d29.expect: With the coin the CREDIT count goes to 01 and the screen turns into the title: PRESS START blinks where INSERT COIN was (as KOF98: a coin on its logo or in its demo goes to its title with PRESS 1P START). The demo fight ends on a coin the same way. START then takes the credit and opens the select screen.

20261007-140341-5d29.title: Select screen: the others in their own colours, darker
20261007-140341-5d29.do: The cursor is on Robert. Look at the fighters around him, then move the cursor right a few times.
20261007-140341-5d29.expect: Every fighter not under the cursor keeps his real colours (Terry's red cap, Ryo's orange gi, Billy's blue) at half brightness, no longer washed out towards grey; the cursor's fighter is in full colour. Locked bosses stay dark silhouettes.

20261007-114307-b3f3.title: Kyo's fury sets Ryo on fire
20261007-114307-b3f3.do: With a full meter and Ryo close in front, press D (Orochinagi). Then the MAX version: down+D.
20261007-114307-b3f3.expect: When the flame hits, Ryo is drawn in flickering orange flames through his fall, as in KOF98, and gets his own colours back on the floor. Same for the MAX version's flames.

20261007-114326-b3f3.title: Kyo's fury hit plays the fire hit sound
20261007-114326-b3f3.do: With a full meter and Ryo close in front, press D (Orochinagi) and listen to the hit.
20261007-114326-b3f3.expect: The flame's hit plays KOF96's fire hit sound (the crackling burn, the same as Kyo's 623C fire hit), not the generic fury impact.

20261007-114458-b3f3.title: Kyo's triple kick is on forward + C
20261007-114458-b3f3.do: Press forward + C. Then up-forward + C.
20261007-114458-b3f3.expect: Forward + C plays his triple kick (EX R.E.D. Kick: three kicks hitting Ryo three times). Up-forward + C now plays the punch rush that forward + C played before (236C, its follow-ups unchanged).

20261007-124603-b3f3.title: Terry's fury straight out of a hold (D while grabbing)
20261007-124603-b3f3.do: Walk into Ryo to grab him, then press D while you hold him (down + D for the MAX fury; it works in the middle of a hold hit too).
20261007-124603-b3f3.expect: The hold ends at once and Terry's fury (Power Geyser) starts and hits Ryo, who reels free out of the hold; nothing can hit Terry while the fury plays. Every fighter does the same.

todo205-hurt-box.title: Terry's Rising Tackle start can't be hit (KOF98's own frames)
todo205-hurt-box.do: In a fight, let enemies come close and attack you, then press up-forward + C (Terry's Rising Tackle, 623D) in the middle of them, several times.
todo205-hurt-box.expect: The first moments of the move (its first 9 frames, the crouch before he rises, as in KOF98) no enemy blow lands on Terry; once he rises he can be hit like in KOF98 (before the fix he could be hit from its first frame).

20261007-145409-5d29.title: Samurai Shodown II's Hanzo: down + A in a jump throws SS2's air shuriken
20261007-145409-5d29.do: Near the Terry in front of you, jump straight up (B), then press down + A in the air. Then jump and press down + A again while a missed shuriken is still stuck in the floor.
20261007-145409-5d29.expect: Hanzo stops in the air, throws a spinning shuriken that flies down and forward at a steep angle and hits Terry (a light reel), then hops a little back and up and lands. A shuriken that misses sticks in the floor, blinks and disappears about a second later; while it is still there, down + A in a jump is the ordinary jumping attack.

todo94-iori-624D.title: Iori's forward + C (624D, Kuzukaze): the catch, played from KOF98's code
todo94-iori-624D.do: Press forward + C with Terry standing close in front of you. Then again with Terry farther away (about half a screen) and once with nobody in reach.
todo94-iori-624D.expect: Iori dashes in, strikes Terry once (a reel), grabs him, Terry crumples at his feet, then a purple explosion throws Terry up in a low arc (burning purple until he lands): his life drops twice, the strike and the explosion, as in KOF98 (the lab's HITS counter also counts the grab). From farther away Iori dashes until he is close, then the same; with nobody in reach he dashes his full length and stops.

todo96-iori-624B.title: Iori's down-forward + C (624B, Kuzukaze, short version): the catch, played from KOF98's code
todo96-iori-624B.do: Press down-forward + C with Terry standing close in front of you. Then again with Terry farther away and once with nobody in reach.
todo96-iori-624B.expect: The same catch as forward + C (a strike, the grab, Terry crumples, the purple explosion throws him up, burning until he lands: his life drops twice, as in KOF98), with a shorter dash: with nobody in reach Iori stops sooner than with forward + C.

todo214-iori-624D.title: Iori's forward + C (624D): the release's explosion from KOF's shared effects
todo214-iori-624D.do: Press forward + C with Terry standing close in front of you and watch the moment Terry is thrown off.
todo214-iori-624D.expect: As Iori lets go, a yellow-white flame flashes along the floor in front of him (part of it behind him), then dark smoke with purple flames bursts around Terry and drifts away while Terry flies off burning purple: the same explosion, colours and timing as KOF98.

todo214-iori-624B.title: Iori's down-forward + C (624B): the release's explosion from KOF's shared effects
todo214-iori-624B.do: Press down-forward + C with Terry standing close in front of you and watch the moment Terry is thrown off.
todo214-iori-624B.expect: The same explosion as forward + C: a yellow-white floor flame, then dark smoke with purple flames around Terry as he flies off, as in KOF98.

todo214-rugal-624A.title: Rugal's forward + C (624A, God Press): the slam's burst from KOF's shared effects
todo214-rugal-624A.do: Press forward + C with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo214-rugal-624A.expect: Rugal rushes, grabs Terry and drives him into the screen's edge; as he slams him against it a white-yellow burst flashes at Terry's chest, then Rugal jumps back: the same burst, colours and timing as KOF98.

todo214-ralf-28A.title: Ralf's down + C ([2]8A): the landing explosion from KOF's shared effects
todo214-ralf-28A.do: Press down + C with Terry standing in front of you and watch Ralf land.
todo214-ralf-28A.expect: Ralf flies up and punches down; where he lands, fire bursts and brown dust clouds roll out on both sides of him and fade: the same explosion, colours and timing as KOF98.

todo214-ralf-28C.title: Ralf's down-forward + C ([2]8C): the landing explosion from KOF's shared effects
todo214-ralf-28C.do: Press down-forward + C with Terry standing in front of you and watch Ralf land.
todo214-ralf-28C.expect: The higher dive of down + C: where Ralf lands, fire bursts and brown dust clouds roll out on both sides of him and fade, as in KOF98.

todo214-ralf-46B.title: Ralf's up + C ([4]6B): the dust behind his kick from KOF's shared effects
todo214-ralf-46B.do: Press up + C with Terry standing in front of you.
todo214-ralf-46B.expect: As Ralf's kick starts, a pale yellow dust cloud puffs up behind his feet (drawn behind him) and fades: the same cloud as KOF98.

todo214-ralf-46D.title: Ralf's up-forward + C ([4]6D): the dust behind his kick from KOF's shared effects
todo214-ralf-46D.do: Press up-forward + C with Terry standing in front of you.
todo214-ralf-46D.expect: As Ralf's kick starts, a pale yellow dust cloud puffs up behind his feet (drawn behind him) and fades, as in KOF98.

todo214-terry-fury.title: Terry's fury (D, Power Geyser 21416C): the dust of the blast from KOF's shared effects
todo214-terry-fury.do: With a full meter, press D with Terry (the dummy) standing in front of you.
todo214-terry-fury.expect: As Terry punches the ground and the geyser erupts, a pale yellow dust cloud puffs up behind him (drawn behind him) and fades: the same cloud as KOF98.

todo212-cheng-specials.title: Cheng-Fu (Double Dragon): his three specials
todo212-cheng-specials.do: Press C, wait until Ryo is up again, press forward + C, wait, then down + C.
todo212-cheng-specials.expect: C: Double Dragon's flying kick (214), a long low leap that knocks Ryo down. Forward + C: the rapid palm strikes (236), Cheng-Fu sliding forward striking again and again with rings at his fist, the last one sending Ryo off. Down + C: the rising uppercut (623) that knocks Ryo down. Each looks and moves as in Double Dragon.

todo212-cheng-furies.title: Cheng-Fu: his two supers (D and down + D)
todo212-cheng-furies.do: With a full meter press D next to Ryo; when both stand again press down + D.
todo212-cheng-furies.expect: D: the screen flashes while he starts his crane kata, then the rush of seven palm strikes (DD's 236 super) with afterimages left behind him. Down + D (orange flash): a low leap with a trail of afterimages; the landing strike catches Ryo, Cheng-Fu holds him and lands a fast flurry, then leaps with the final uppercut that knocks Ryo down (nine hits, as in Double Dragon).

todo212-cheng-throw.title: Cheng-Fu: his throw is Double Dragon's stun strike
todo212-cheng-throw.do: Walk into Ryo to grab him, then forward + A. While Ryo staggers dizzy, press A.
todo212-cheng-throw.expect: Cheng-Fu strikes Ryo's chest with his palm and blows the dust off his fingers; Ryo stands stunned, staggers back and stays dizzy about two seconds (no damage from the throw itself, as in Double Dragon); the A hits him while he is dizzy.

todo136-kim-421A.title: Kim: up + C is Kizuna's 421A, the dummy held where it was caught
todo136-kim-421A.do: Press up + C next to the dummy, then once from far away.
todo136-kim-421A.expect: Kim lunges with the staff. On the hit the dummy stays frozen where he struck it while he is pushed back, then his two blows launch it: up into a short arc, then kicked high and away; it lands and bounces down. Three hits (in Kizuna his tag partner jumps in for two more: the brawler has no partner). From far away he lunges and recovers.

todo138-kim-6246A.title: Kim: D is Kizuna's Phoenix (6246A), its victim moved by Kizuna's own reaction code
todo138-kim-6246A.do: Press D next to the dummy (full meter).
todo138-kim-6246A.expect: The flash pose, then the rush; on the hit a flurry of staff blows keeps the dummy reeling in place, a launch and a rising kick throw it up, Kim chases it into the air (the white / red strobing screen) and hits it twice more; it freezes at the top while Kim dives down in flames, then falls the rest of the way and bounces once he has landed. Twelve hits.

todo215-cheng-super623.title: Cheng-Fu's down + D: Double Dragon's hit sparks and red flashes
todo215-cheng-super623.do: With a full meter press down + D next to Ryo.
todo215-cheng-super623.expect: The leap, the catch and the flurry: on every hit the screen flashes red twice (the stage turns solid red for 2 frames, back for 2, red for 2 more), as in Double Dragon; each hit draws Double Dragon's own spark at the impact (rings / crescents that flicker pink, yellow, green and blue and fly a little away from Cheng-Fu), not the round white-orange KOF spark; the final uppercut a bigger burst.

todo215-cheng-super236.title: Cheng-Fu's D: seven palm strikes with Double Dragon's sparks and red flashes
todo215-cheng-super236.do: With a full meter press D next to Ryo.
todo215-cheng-super236.expect: After the flash pose, the rush of seven palm strikes: on every hit the screen flashes red twice (the stage turns solid red for 2 frames, back for 2, red for 2 more), as in Double Dragon; each strike draws Double Dragon's flickering ring spark at Ryo's chest.

todo215-cheng-specials.title: Cheng-Fu's specials and normals: Double Dragon's hit sparks, no red
todo215-cheng-specials.do: Press C, wait until Ryo is up, forward + C, wait, down + C, wait, then A A A.
todo215-cheng-specials.expect: Every hit draws Double Dragon's spark (rings / crescents flickering pink, yellow, green, blue; bigger for the heavy hits), never the KOF spark; the screen never turns red (only supers do that).

todo215-billy-super236.title: Billy Lee's D: Double Dragon's hit sparks and red flashes
todo215-billy-super236.do: With a full meter press D next to Ryo.
todo215-billy-super236.expect: The five-hit rush: on every hit the screen flashes red twice (the stage turns solid red for 2 frames, back for 2, red for 2 more), as in Double Dragon; each hit draws Double Dragon's spark, growing bigger hit after hit.

todo215-billy-specials.title: Billy Lee's specials and normals: Double Dragon's hit sparks, no red
todo215-billy-specials.do: Press C, wait until Ryo is up, forward + C, wait, down + C, wait, then A A A.
todo215-billy-specials.expect: Every hit draws Double Dragon's flickering spark, never the KOF spark; no red screen.

todo215-billy-super-specials.title: Super Billy's specials: Double Dragon's hit sparks
todo215-billy-super-specials.do: Press down + C next to Ryo, wait until he is up, then up + C.
todo215-billy-super-specials.expect: The rising double hit and the flying kick each draw Double Dragon's spark at the impact (no KOF spark, no red).

todo217-kim-phoenix-strobe.title: Kim's Phoenix: the white / red strobe flashes whole frames
todo217-kim-phoenix-strobe.do: Press D next to the dummy (full meter): the Phoenix.
todo217-kim-phoenix-strobe.expect: While Kim chases the dummy into the air the whole screen strobes white / red every frame, never a frame half red / half white, also its last one before the stage comes back.

todo218-cheng-far-d.title: Cheng-Fu's far D: Double Dragon's two moves, the hop kick after the first
todo218-cheng-far-d.do: Press forward + A (his far D) with Ryo in front of him, then again with nobody in reach.
todo218-cheng-far-d.expect: Cheng-Fu steps in with a low strike, then at once hops forward with a flying kick, as in Double Dragon: two hits on Ryo (the first makes him reel, the kick knocks him down), each with Double Dragon's spark; with nobody in reach he plays both moves the same way.

todo218-cheng-down-attack.title: Cheng-Fu's down attack: up / down + A leaps onto a lying enemy (Double Dragon's 8 / 2 + button)
todo218-cheng-down-attack.do: Press C (his flying kick knocks Ryo down), then as soon as Cheng-Fu stands, while Ryo still lies, press down + A (or up + A).
todo218-cheng-down-attack.expect: Cheng-Fu crouches, leaps high in a spinning somersault leaving afterimages, and lands feet first on the lying Ryo: one hit with Double Dragon's spark that bounces Ryo off the floor; Cheng-Fu then hops back. Ryo stays down until the stomp lands. Down + A with nobody lying is his normal crouch attack.

todo216-ralf-AAAA.title: Ralf's C (AAAA, Vulcan Punch): played from KOF98's handler, with its dust clouds
todo216-ralf-AAAA.do: Press C with Terry standing a step in front of you.
todo216-ralf-AAAA.expect: Ralf winds up, then throws a long flurry of punches: a brown dust cloud puffs from his fists every few frames (five in all) and Terry, caught by the first punches, is blown away burning; Ralf then recovers: the same timing and clouds as KOF98.

todo216-yamazaki-fury.title: Yamazaki's fury (D, Guillotine 236236C): played from KOF98's handler
todo216-yamazaki-fury.do: With a full meter, press D with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo216-yamazaki-fury.expect: After the flash Yamazaki leaps at Terry, a dark swirl trailing his jump, catches him in the air and lands with him, then drags him along the floor in two long pulls, striking him four times on each, and ends with a last blow that sends Terry flying: the same moves and timing as KOF98 (no purple afterimages: the brawler draws none).

todo216-iori-fury.title: Iori's fury (D, Ura 23624C): played from KOF98's handler, its finisher and explosion
todo216-iori-fury.do: With a full meter, press D with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo216-iori-fury.expect: After the flash Iori dashes, grabs Terry and claws him seven times while Terry stays held in front of him; then Iori grabs him by the head, a purple flame flares, and the explosion's yellow flame and purple smoke burst as Terry is blown away burning purple: the same moves, hits and timing as KOF98.

todo213-rosa-236C.title: Rosa: C is Kizuna's 236C, a shockwave along the floor
todo213-rosa-236C.do: Press C, then again from across the screen.
todo213-rosa-236C.expect: Rosa strikes the floor; a dark shockwave runs along the ground, hits the dummy (it reels) and bursts. From far it travels about 240 px and vanishes.

todo213-rosa-214B.title: Rosa: forward + C is Kizuna's 214B, its two follow-ups
todo213-rosa-214B.do: Press forward + C next to the dummy; again, then press forward + C once more during the hits; again, then forward + A during the hits.
todo213-rosa-214B.expect: A lunging three-hit sword combo. With forward + C again: she grabs the dummy and throws it far behind her onto the floor (it lies, then gets up). With forward + A: a fourth upward slash that knocks it down. Without a follow-up she recovers.

todo213-rosa-623C.title: Rosa: down + C is Kizuna's 623C rising kick, A for the second kick
todo213-rosa-623C.do: Press down + C next to the dummy, then A while it is in the air.
todo213-rosa-623C.expect: A rising kick that launches the dummy (three hits); with A after the hit a second kick in the air knocks it down; she floats down and lands.

todo213-rosa-421C.title: Rosa: up + C is Kizuna's 421C, a back-hop slash
todo213-rosa-421C.do: Press up + C next to the dummy.
todo213-rosa-421C.expect: She hops back with a downward slash; the dummy reels; she lands and recovers.

todo213-rosa-63214C.title: Rosa: down-forward + C is Kizuna's 63214C barrier
todo213-rosa-63214C.do: Press down-forward + C next to the dummy.
todo213-rosa-63214C.expect: A blue crescent barrier forms in front of her and drifts forward; it knocks the dummy down.

todo213-rosa-6246A.title: Rosa: D is Kizuna's 6246A, the grab, the throw and the aerial chase
todo213-rosa-6246A.do: Press D next to the dummy (full meter), with room behind Rosa.
todo213-rosa-6246A.expect: The flash pose, a rush; on the hit she grabs the dummy and flips it over her shoulder high into the air behind her, turns, leaps after it and kicks it five times, then dives onto it: the screen goes black until she lands; it crashes down and gets up.

todo213-rosa-421A.title: Rosa: down + D is Kizuna's 421A, the lunge and the held victim
todo213-rosa-421A.do: Press down + D next to the dummy (full meter).
todo213-rosa-421A.expect: The flash pose, a lunging slash; on the hit the dummy freezes where it was struck, her next blows launch it high. Three hits (in Kizuna her tag partner adds two: the brawler has no partner).

todo213-rosa-j2C.title: Rosa: down + A in a jump is Kizuna's j.2C dive, down + A again for the rising kick
todo213-rosa-j2C.do: Jump forward toward the dummy, press down + A near the top, then down + A again as it hits.
todo213-rosa-j2C.expect: She dives at 45 degrees with her sword; on the hit she keeps diving and strikes again; with down + A again she stops, rises with a kick that knocks the dummy down and lands. Without a hit she lands and recovers.

todo220-iori-max.title: Iori's MAX fury (down+D, MAX 23624C): ten strikes from KOF98's handler
todo220-iori-max.do: With a full meter, hold down and press D with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo220-iori-max.expect: After the orange flash Iori dashes, grabs Terry and strikes him ten times in a row while Terry stays held in front of him; the last strike sets off the yellow flame and purple smoke explosion and Terry is blown away burning purple: the same strikes, hits and timing as KOF98's MAX version.

todo220-yamazaki-max.title: Yamazaki's MAX fury (down+D, MAX 236236C): from KOF98's handler, the long guillotine at the end
todo220-yamazaki-max.do: With a full meter, hold down and press D with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo220-yamazaki-max.expect: After the orange flash Yamazaki leaps on Terry, lands with him and drags him in three long pulls, striking him on each; Terry is left standing, Yamazaki's snake arm takes him again and lashes him several more times, and the last lash launches Terry high into the air: the same moves, hits and timing as KOF98's MAX version.

todo220-yamazaki-fury.title: Yamazaki's fury (D, 236236C): all of KOF98's hits, the catch's pause as short as KOF's
todo220-yamazaki-fury.do: With a full meter, press D with Terry standing close in front of you.
todo220-yamazaki-fury.expect: Yamazaki leaps at Terry with a dark swirl, catches him and drags him in two pulls; Terry takes 12 hits in all (two at once as the second pull starts, one as the drag ends) before the last blow sends him flying, as in KOF98; Yamazaki moves on right as the swirl fades.

todo220-ralf-mash.title: Ralf's C (AAAA): pressing C again during the punches repeats them, as in KOF98
todo220-ralf-mash.do: Press C with Terry a step in front of you, then press C once more right away while Ralf punches.
todo220-ralf-mash.expect: Ralf's flurry of punches plays a second time before he recovers (ten dust clouds instead of five); a press later than about a third of a second after the first does nothing, as in KOF98.

todo222-yashiro-max-rush.title: Yashiro's fury and MAX always play the full punch rush, no mashing needed
todo222-yashiro-max-rush.do: With Terry right in front of you and a full meter, press D and let go. When Yashiro has recovered and Terry is back up, press down+D.
todo222-yashiro-max-rush.expect: D: the full punch rush, 13 hits (five flurries, then the finisher) without pressing anything else. Down+D (MAX): 23 hits (nine flurries, then the MAX finisher).

rv1b-attack-tokens.title: At most 3 enemies come at you at once; the rest wait around you
rv1b-attack-tokens.do: Stage 5, the first wave (6 enemies). Stand still for 20 seconds and watch them (you will take hits; that is fine).
rv1b-attack-tokens.expect: Never more than 3 of them walk in, get ready or attack at the same time; the others stand spread out around you (both sides, two rings), and one of them steps in only when an attacker has finished, been hit or knocked down.

rv1b-ready-pose.title: Before every attack the enemy shows a ready stance for a moment
rv1b-ready-pose.do: Stage 1, the first wave. Stand still and watch each enemy as it comes in close.
rv1b-ready-pose.expect: In range it stops and holds a stance that is not its idle (Terry, Ryo, Kyo: the fist pulled back of their strong punch) for a random moment, from a blink to a second, then strikes. Its idle breathing never turns straight into a punch without that pose.

rv1b-windup.title: Wind-up by damage: jabs come fast, specials are announced
rv1b-windup.do: Stage 1's boss (Mr. Big) alone, 120 px in front of you. Stand still and watch his attacks for 20 seconds.
rv1b-windup.expect: His jabs come out quickly after his ready stance (a tenth of a second); before a special he freezes in its first pose for about half a second, so you can see it coming and jump or walk away.

rv1b-rank.title: Playing well makes the enemies keener (hidden rank)
rv1b-rank.do: Stage 1: clear the waves fast without getting hit (the Brawler Lab's status line shows 'rank n'). Then let yourself be beaten once.
rv1b-rank.expect: The rank starts at 8 and climbs (a wave cleared fast: +1, untouched: +1, every 10 seconds without a hit: +1): the enemies wait less before attacking and rest less between attacks, and from rank 11 newly arriving enemies hit 1 harder (2 from 22). Losing a life drops it by 4. It is never shown in the game itself.

rv1a-chain-length.title: Chains by archetype: Kim 5 links, Terry 4, Krauser 3
rv1a-chain-length.do: Tap A steadily (about four taps a second) against the dummy. Then do the same with Terry and with Krauser.
rv1a-chain-length.expect: Kim (fast) hits five times, the fifth knocks the dummy down; Terry (balanced) four times; Krauser (heavy) three, each hit slower and harder. The whole chain takes 21 (Kim), 23 (Terry) and 27 (Krauser) of the dummy's 60 life, shown at the bottom.

rv1a-whiff-reset.title: A chain goes on only on hits: a miss starts it again
rv1a-whiff-reset.do: Far from the dummy, tap A three times. Then walk up and tap A twice so the first jab hits.
rv1a-whiff-reset.expect: Every miss plays the first jab again (never the second or third link of the chain). Up close, the jab hits and the next tap plays the second link.

rv1a-window.title: The next link waits a little more than half a second
rv1a-window.do: Tap A once (the jab hits), wait about half a second, tap A again. Then let the dummy recover, tap A, and wait a full second before the next tap.
rv1a-window.expect: After the short wait Terry plays the second link of his chain (the far jab); after the long wait the jab starts the chain again.

rv1a-buffer.title: A press during the hit freeze is never lost
rv1a-buffer.do: Tap A once; tap it again exactly when the first hit lands (during the freeze), and once more on the next hit.
rv1a-buffer.expect: Each next link starts on the very first frame after the freeze, the three hits flow without a gap. A tap made long before a hit (more than 5 frames) is not kept.

rv1a-finisher-up.title: Finishers by direction: up + A launches
rv1a-finisher-up.do: A, A, A, then hold up and press A for the last hit. Then try the last hit with forward, down, back and no direction.
rv1a-finisher-up.expect: Up: the far kick launches the dummy high (juggle it). Forward: a push that sends it flying away. Down: a sweep that trips it. Back: Terry grabs it and throws it behind him, nothing can hit him during the throw. No direction: the knockdown kick.

rv1a-back-throw.title: Back + A on the last link throws the enemy behind, into the one standing there
rv1a-back-throw.do: A, A, A, then hold back and press A for the last hit.
rv1a-back-throw.expect: Terry grabs the dummy, throws it behind him; its body knocks down the second dummy standing behind Terry. Terry is untouchable during the throw; the throw does not continue the chain.

rv1a-slam.title: A heavy's down finisher: a ground slam that bounces
rv1a-slam.do: A, A, then hold down and press A for the last hit (Ralf: Krauser's down finisher is his crouch D sweep since revamp 3b).
rv1a-slam.expect: The dummy is slammed to the floor at once and bounces up high, where it can be juggled before it falls.

rv1a-juggle-cap.title: Juggles stop at 5 air hits; a fighter on the floor cannot be hit
rv1a-juggle-cap.do: Ralf: A, A, then down + A (the slam: the dummy bounces up), then keep tapping A at it in the air, and keep tapping once it lies down. (Ralf since revamp 3b: Krauser's down finisher is now his crouch D sweep.)
rv1a-juggle-cap.expect: The slam bounces the dummy up; whatever reaches it in the air lands, never more than five hits in one juggle (then your attacks pass through it until it lands; the default chains seldom reach five, tools/brawler/chain_proof.py proves the cap). Once it has touched the floor nothing hits it until it is standing again.

rv1a-player-stun.title: Hit by an enemy: a short stun and a moment no one else can hit you
rv1a-player-stun.do: Stage 1, wave 2: stand in the middle of the enemies and let them hit you.
rv1a-player-stun.expect: Each hit stuns Terry only briefly (about a quarter of a second) and for a moment after it the other enemies' punches pass through him: a crowd can no longer juggle you; the enemy that hit you may follow up.

rv2-meter-special.title: A special costs one stock: one of the three dots empties
rv2-meter-special.do: The meter under your name is full: the bar and three filled dots. Press C once (Terry's special).
rv2-meter-special.expect: The special plays; the bar loses a third and one dot becomes an empty ring (two filled dots left). The bar then refills slowly (a full stock in about 7 seconds) and the dot fills again when its third is back.

rv2-meter-life.title: No stock left: a special costs a little life instead
rv2-meter-life.do: Your meter is under one stock (all three dots empty). Press C once.
rv2-meter-life.expect: The special still plays, but your life bar drops by a tenth (6 of 60) and the meter stays where it was.

rv2-breaker.title: Breaker: a special while you are hit costs two stocks and makes you blink
rv2-breaker.do: Mr. Big alone in front of you, your meter full. Stand still; the moment his blow hits you, press C while you reel.
rv2-breaker.expect: Terry escapes with his special straight out of the hit; his body blinks white the whole time it plays (the extra cost shown) and two of the three dots empty at once.

rv2-breaker-life.title: Breaker with less than two stocks: it costs life instead
rv2-breaker-life.do: Mr. Big alone, your meter at one and a half stocks. Stand still; when his blow hits you, press C while you reel.
rv2-breaker-life.expect: The breaker still plays and Terry blinks white through it, but the meter is not touched: your life bar drops by a fifth (12 of 60) on top of his blow.

rv2-no-breaker.title: No meter and too little life: no breaker
rv2-no-breaker.do: Mr. Big alone, your meter empty and your life low (16 of 60: you also blink red). Stand still; when his blow hits you, press C while you reel.
rv2-no-breaker.expect: Nothing happens: Terry reels to the end of the hit. A breaker needs two stocks or more than 12 life, and you have neither.

rv2-fury.title: The fury costs the whole meter
rv2-fury.expect: Power Geyser plays with its blue super flash; all three dots empty and the bar is empty. It takes half the dummy's life (30 of 60, shown at the bottom).

rv2-max-red.title: The MAX: only in the red state (life a quarter or less)
rv2-max-red.do: Your life is low (12 of 60): Terry blinks red and MAX blinks next to your dots. The dummy stands a little away (all three geysers reach it there). Hold down and press D.
rv2-max-red.expect: MAX Power Geyser plays with its orange super flash, the whole meter spent; its three geysers take three quarters of the dummy's life (45 of 60).

rv2-max-not-red.title: Down + D outside the red state is the plain fury
rv2-max-not-red.do: Full life, full meter. Hold down and press D.
rv2-max-not-red.expect: The plain fury (Power Geyser, blue flash, 30 damage) plays, not the MAX: no red blinking, no MAX mark.

rv3-ralf-426.title: Ralf: hold + up + A is KOF98's 426 backbreaker
rv3-ralf-426.do: You hold Ryo. Press up + A.
rv3-ralf-426.expect: Ralf tosses Ryo off the top of the screen, catches him coming down and slams him behind him (two impacts, 12 of the dummy's 60). Ralf cannot be hit while he throws. No meter spent.

rv3-super-throw.title: Super throw: hold + forward + C with a stock
rv3-super-throw.do: You hold Ryo, meter full (three dots). Press forward + C.
rv3-super-throw.expect: The blue super flash over the hold, then Terry's forward throw dealing 18 (not 12); one dot empties.

rv3-super-throw-empty.title: Super throw without meter: the plain throw
rv3-super-throw-empty.do: You hold Ryo with an empty meter. Press forward + C.
rv3-super-throw-empty.expect: No flash: Terry's ordinary forward throw (12 damage); no life paid.

rv3-rosa-super.title: Rosa: her 6246A grab is now her super throw
rv3-rosa-super.do: You hold Ryo, meter full. Press forward + C.
rv3-rosa-super.expect: Rosa lets go, the super flash, then her 6246A grab, throw and aerial chase on Ryo (18 damage); one dot empties. Her D is now 421A.

rv3-iori-extra.title: Iori: hold + up + A plays 624B as a throw
rv3-iori-extra.do: You hold Ryo. Press up + A.
rv3-iori-extra.expect: Iori lets go and his 624B catch takes Ryo at once (12 damage, no meter). Forward + C (super throw) plays 624D. Forward + C (the special slot) no longer plays 624D.

rv3-throw-body.title: A thrown body knocks the others down
rv3-throw-body.do: You hold Ryo; a second Ryo stands 140 px ahead. Press forward + A.
rv3-throw-body.expect: Terry throws Ryo forward; the flying body knocks the second Ryo down. Terry cannot be hit during the throw.

rv3b-krauser-chain.title: Krauser's chain: close C, far D, crouch C
rv3b-krauser-chain.do: Tap A three times, a tap on each hit, no direction.
rv3b-krauser-chain.expect: Three hits: the close punch, the far kick, then the crouching uppercut that knocks the dummy down. 27 damage in all. None of the light pieces (far A / B, close B, crouch A / B) ever plays.

rv3b-krauser-forward.title: Krauser forward finisher: far C push
rv3b-krauser-forward.do: A, A, then hold forward and press A for the third hit.
rv3b-krauser-forward.expect: The third hit is his far C punch; it pushes the dummy away to a knockdown.

rv3b-krauser-up.title: Krauser up finisher: close D launcher
rv3b-krauser-up.do: A, A, then hold up and press A for the third hit.
rv3b-krauser-up.expect: The third hit is his close D, the kick that points up: the dummy is launched high (juggle it).

rv3b-krauser-down.title: Krauser down finisher: crouch D sweep
rv3b-krauser-down.do: A, A, then hold down and press A for the third hit.
rv3b-krauser-down.expect: The third hit is his crouching D sweep: the dummy is knocked down at once.

rv3b-krauser-back.title: Krauser back finisher: his throw
rv3b-krauser-back.do: A, A, then hold back and press A for the third hit.
rv3b-krauser-back.expect: Krauser grabs the dummy and throws it behind him; nothing can hit him during the throw.

rv3b-grab-fury.title: Rugal's fury on D is still Gigantic Pressure (a grab, provisional)
rv3b-grab-fury.do: Meter full (three dots), the dummy a few steps away. Press D.
rv3b-grab-fury.expect: The super flash, Rugal leaps onto the dummy and crushes it (30 damage when both crushes land; at some spacings only one lands: 15). All three dots spent; nothing can hit Rugal during it. Yamazaki (Guillotine) and Genjuro (his rage grab) keep theirs on D the same way.

rv3b-grab-super.title: Yamazaki's super throw: hold + forward + C = the Guillotine
rv3b-grab-super.do: You hold Ryo, meter full. Press forward + C.
rv3b-grab-super.expect: The super flash, then the Guillotine on Ryo for 18 damage; one dot empties (on D the same grab is his fury, all three dots).

20261008-143545-5d29.title: Terry opens with the far A jab
20261008-143545-5d29.do: Press A once, Ryo a step away.
20261008-143545-5d29.expect: Terry's first hit is the far A jab (a straight arm jab), not another animation.

20261008-173846-5d29.title: A Blitz never cancels into a Blitz
20261008-173846-5d29.do: Forward, forward + A (Body Toss), and while it plays do forward, forward + A again.
20261008-173846-5d29.expect: Only ONE Body Toss: the second one doesn't come out until the first has ended.

20261008-180101-5d29.do: Turn the hit boxes on, then press A and C with Ryo a bit too far.
20261008-180101-5d29.expect: The red attack box ends at Terry's fist / foot, no longer far beyond it: a move only hits when the drawn limb reaches Ryo.

20261008-175839-5d29.title: Run: frames 1.5x faster, same speed
20261008-175839-5d29.do: Run: forward, forward and hold forward.
20261008-175839-5d29.expect: The run's legs cycle visibly faster than on 0.8.0 while Terry covers the ground at the same speed.

20261008-175917-5d29.title: Walk: frames 1.5x faster, same speed
20261008-175917-5d29.expect: The walk's steps switch visibly faster than on 0.8.0 while Terry still walks at Cody's speed.

20261008-181001-5d29.title: Bosses have double life
20261008-181001-5d29.do: Stage 1, Mr. Big alone in front of Terry. Fight him.
20261008-181001-5d29.expect: Mr. Big has 200 life: his bar drains about half as fast per hit as before.

20261008-182850-5d29.title: Terry: forward + C = the light Power Dunk
20261008-182850-5d29.expect: The light Power Dunk (623B: a lower, shorter jump than before), one drive chunk spent.
